plugins.name: markitdown-gemini
plugins.description: mcp-markitdown-gemini: a microsoft/markitdown-mcp-compatible MCP server exposing convert_to_markdown for http/https/file/data URIs. Optional Gemini-based PDF conversion when GEMINI_API_KEY is set. Install with install_claude_plugin.sh (Linux/macOS) or install_claude_plugin.ps1 (Windows).
